# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** school teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Stacy  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>; Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a young woman who possesses fair curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully, wearing sleeve puffs larger than anyone else's in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a bright, sympathetic young woman with the gift of winning and holding the affections of her pupils and bringing out the best in them mentally and morally. She is gentle and forgiving, preferring to reason with her students rather than punish them harshly.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the school trustees as the first female teacher in Avonlea. She introduced innovative teaching methods, including morning and evening physical culture exercises, nature study field days in the woods, and bi-weekly recitation afternoons. She established strong, encouraging relationships with her students, guiding them on their reading habits and moral development. Later, she organized a Queen's class to prepare interested pupils for the Entrance examination to Queen's Academy, drilling them thoroughly throughout the term. Her teaching was completely successful, as every member of her Queen's class passed the Entrance examinations. She concluded her term at Avonlea school at the end of June, leaving her pupils tearful and grateful for her guidance.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042)_
